description:
Manage Focus tasks with the following actions:

- **create-task**: Create a task with related data such as subtasks and an initial time entry. For payload.task and each payload.subtasks[] item: Send start_date and end_date together, with end_date on or after start_date; for a single due date, send both as that day. (data: payload*{task*, estimate_allocations, subtasks, time_entry})
- **archive** (data: from_recurring_task_id, scope, task_id*)
- **attachments-bulk-create**: Uploads several local files in one call. names and display_orders are optional parallel arrays; they default to the file basenames and array positions. (data: task_id*, file_paths*, names, display_orders)
- **attachments-create**: Uploads a local file (file_path) as an attachment. The mime type is inferred from the extension and the API rejects disallowed types; uploads are capped at 20 MB. (data: task_id*, file_path*, name, display_order)
- **attachments-delete** (data: attachment_id*, task_id*)
- **attachments-list**: Lists attachment metadata. Upload files with attachments-create (file_path), download with attachments-view (save_to). (data: order_by, task_id*)
- **attachments-update**: Full update (PUT): both name and display_order are required; the response body is empty, verify via attachments-list. (data: attachment_id*, payload*{display_order*, name*}, task_id*)
- **attachments-view**: Downloads the attachment's binary content to a local path (save_to). Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true. (data: task_id*, attachment_id*, save_to*, overwrite)
- **bulk-archive** (data: task_ids*)
- **bulk-create** (data: tasks*)
- **bulk-delete**: Deletes all listed task IDs in one HTTP call. Requires confirm flow like single delete. (data: ids*, outbound_sync)
- **bulk-duplicate** (data: cascade_duplicate_children*, task_ids*, private)
- **bulk-patch**: Prefer over many single updates: pass a JSON array of { id: taskId, ...partial fields }. Same field names and date guidance as single task update. (data: array payload)
- **bulk-restore** (data: task_ids*)
- **bulk-unarchive** (data: task_ids*)
- **constraints-list** (data: none)
- **constraints-upsert** (data: payload*{enabled*, required_fields*})
- **create**: Required: name. Strongly recommended: project_id, status_id, assignee_user_ids. Use start_date/end_date for scheduling as date-only YYYY-MM-DD values; never pass RFC 3339 datetimes. Send start_date and end_date together, with end_date on or after start_date; for a single due date, send both as that day. Set estimated_mins for time estimates. (data: name*, allocation_unit, assignee_user_ids, auto_log_time, billable, color, custom_fields, description, end_date, estimate_type, estimated_mins, notes, parent_task_id, pinned, position, priority, priority_at, private, project_id, rollup_enabled, rrule, start_date, status_id, tag_ids, team_assignee_ids)
- **create-recurring-occurrence** (data: return_occurrence, task_id*)
- **delete**: Permanently deletes the task and all its subtasks. Cannot be undone. (data: task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-create** (data: payload*, task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-delete** (data: id, task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-list** (data: task_id*)
- **estimate-allocations-update** (data: payload*, task_id*)
- **get**: Fetch a single task with full detail including subtasks and time estimates. (data: task_id*)
- **get-by-external-id** (data: ext_id*, source*)
- **get-calendar-events** (data: calendar_event_id, date_from, date_to, hidden)
- **get-delete-impact** (data: from_recurring_task_id, ids*)
- **get-picker-task-children** (data: include_unassigned, only_me, page, parent_task_id*, per_page, project_id, search, unified_search, without_project)
- **get-picker-task-groups** (data: include_unassigned, occurrence_window_date, occurrence_window_days, only_me, page, per_page, pinned_only, project_id, search, unified_search, without_project)
- **get-recurring-instances** (data: archived, assignee_team_id, assignee_user_id, dates_overlap_end, dates_overlap_start, end_date, include_assignees, page, per_page, recurring_task_ids, start_date, tag_id, team_id)
- **get-stream** (data: active_by_date, active_project, archived, assignee_team_id, assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, dates_overlap_end, dates_overlap_start, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, estimated_mins_max, estimated_mins_min, has_dates, has_time_entries, ids, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_parent_matches, include_project_completed, is_priority, name, occurrence_window_date, occurrence_window_days, order_by, parent_task_id, pinned, priority, private, project_id, recurring, recurring_task_ids, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, state, status_id, tag_id, team_id, toggl_user_id, with_entries)
- **get-with-children** (data: archived, assignee_user_id, include_assignees, order_by, page, per_page, source, status_id, tag_id, task_id*, team_id)
- **get-with-parents** (data: archived, assignee_user_id, include_assignees, order_by, page, per_page, source, status_id, tag_id, task_id*, team_id)
- **groups-get** (data: assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, collapse_recurring, creator_id, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, exclude_empty, group*, group_id, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_unassigned, include_unmaterialized, min_days, name, order_by, page, per_page, priority, private, project_id, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, status_id, tag_id, team_id, user_cf_filter, user_tag_id, xTimelineFetchTrigger)
- **groups-get-user-task-groups-by-project** (data: assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, collapse_recurring, creator_id, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, exclude_empty, group_id, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_unassigned, include_unmaterialized, min_days, name, priority, private, project_id*, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, status_id, tag_id, team_id, user_cf_filter, user_tag_id, xTimelineFetchTrigger)
- **groups-get-user-task-groups-by-team** (data: assignee_user_id, cf_filter, client_id, collapse_recurring, creator_id, end_date, end_date_from, end_date_to, exclude_empty, group_id, include_assignees, include_drafts, include_unassigned, include_unmaterialized, min_days, name, priority, private, project_id, source, start_date, start_date_from, start_date_to, status_id, tag_id, team_id, user_cf_filter, user_tag_id, xTimelineFetchTrigger)
- **groups-update** (data: group*, payload*)
- **list**: Filter by start_date/end_date (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-04-27') for date ranges, project_id, status_id, or assignee_user_id. Returns paginated results — use page/per_page for more. Use parent_task_id to list subtasks. Priority values: none, low, medium, high. (data: name, status_id, project_id, tag_id, assignee_user_id, priority, start_date, end_date, parent_task_id, page, per_page)
- **pin** (data: task_id*)
- **restore** (data: scope, task_id*)
- **suggestions-get-project-suggestion-for-atask** (data: payload*{task_id*})
- **suggestions-get-project-suggestions-for-multiple-tasks** (data: payload*{task_ids*})
- **unarchive** (data: scope, task_id*)
- **unpin** (data: task_id*)
- **update**: Partial update — only include fields to change in payload. Provide task_id at top level and the fields to update under payload. custom_fields writes values as a map keyed by custom field ID; reads return the same data as custom_field_values[], so the write shape is not the read shape. Send start_date and end_date together, with end_date on or after start_date; to move one date, resend the task's current other date; if the task has none, or that breaks the order, send the new date as both. (data: task_id*, payload*{...})
- **full-update**: Follow the update action's date guidance. (data: payload*{...}, task_id*)
- **update-calendar-range** (data: date_from*, date_to*, skip_provider_refresh)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
